findings.text: select_profile_backend has no production caller, appearing only in tests/test_flight.py, so the refusal the goal names cannot fire in production; its sibling select_local_backend is called from reckon/cli.py:1166 and reckon/crew/recovery.py:491, so the wiring pattern exists and is absent here, and a profile routed on a lane that never receives the image would still be answered.

PROFILE_INPUT_MODALITIES declares the figure profile as requiring image input while no backend in any configuration layer declares it, so the profile resolves nowhere until a lane declares the modality and the section's refusal is unreachable in the shipped configuration.

the anchor states that the other 84 tests in the declared gate were unaffected, while negative_control.log:10 reports those 84 as deselected rather than run, so that half of the claim rests on the absence of a run rather than on a green one.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 91e4095a: f2ea9301 adds the InputModality enum and the input_modalities slot to the LinkML source at reckon/schema/flight.yaml:104 and :334, regenerates reckon/_flight_schema.py:172, and adds the modality helpers and select_profile_backend at reckon/flight.py:759-870 with six cases at tests/test_flight.py:1439-1547; 5b1759ab lands the plan record and the evidence anchor; 428477c7 regenerates the served JSON schema; every hunk is insertions only.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for the schema slot and the regenerated model with a test asserting they agree, the codex backends declaring image input, refusal tests naming the backend and the word image with no fall-through, the applied negative control logged, and a green gate over tests/test_flight.py and tests/test_backend_reference_contract.py; gate.log:1 names both files and gate.log:4 records 93 passed, and my independent re-run at the landed revision reproduced 93 passed EXIT=0 with the round-trip pair running rather than skipping once the environment's console scripts are on PATH; the codex-declaration clause carries no evidence because it was not landed.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that BackendConfig carries an input-modalities slot, the codex backends declare image input, and a figure profile routed to a backend declaring no image input is refused naming the backend and the missing capability; reckon/schema/flight.yaml:104 declares the closed InputModality enum and reckon/flight.py:765 the PROFILE_INPUT_MODALITIES map, and reckon/flight.py:812 refuses by name, but no layer sets input_modalities on any backend, so the codex-declaration clause of the goal is unlanded.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; status complete, commits f2ea9301, 5b1759ab and 428477c7, and its gate, test_logs, negative_control_log, negative_control_note and blockers fields each match the artefact they name rather than standing in for one.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares seven paths and git diff --stat 91e4095a 428477c7 is insertions only, 404 lines over exactly those seven plus docs/_shared/flight.schema.json, which is outside the fence and named as such in the manifest's own blockers field.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control at negative_control.log:1 repeats the declared string verbatim and negative_control.log:8-10 shows exactly the two refusal tests reddening with DID NOT RAISE when the slot check is replaced by a fall-through, so the guard is demonstrated to fire; tests/test_flight.py:1472 is a validation echo that supplies the value it asserts back and reddens only because a missing field raises.
justifications.evidence: gate.log:4 records 93 passed and I reproduced 93 passed EXIT=0 at 428477c7, but the done_when's codex-declaration clause is unlanded and gate.log:1 names the base revision 91e4095a rather than the landed head the command tested.
justifications.fit: reckon/flight.py:812 sits beside the sibling select_local_backend at reckon/flight.py:731 and raises FlightConfigError in the same resolved-flight key-path form as its neighbours, and no name in the diff carries a plan label or ticket reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/flight.py:812 refuses a figure profile by name on a lane declaring no image, but the codex lanes the goal names carry no declaration and no production path calls the resolver, so a figure profile cannot be served today.
justifications.scope_discipline: six of the seven changed paths are inside the declared fence; docs/_shared/flight.schema.json is outside it and the run's own check.log records it as the sole out-of-scope path, disclosed in the manifest and required by the committed round-trip test.
